meta.objective: frozen-H_FN Rayleigh quotient of b=a_k exp(r_theta)
meta.estimator: reweight: one fixed set of --budget i.i.d. samples of the exact a_k^2 per loop iteration; E_hat = sum w E_loc / sum w, w = exp(2 r); E_loc(x)=sum_y F[x,y] b(y)/b(x) from local rows of H_FN[a_k,s_k]; SR gradient 2<(E_loc-E)(O-<O>)>_w, Fisher <(O-<O>)(O-<O>)^T>_w on unique train configs (CG); step accepted only if the held-out val estimate decreases (early stop at first reject)
meta.network: residual translational 2D ViT (4 layers, d=60, 10 heads, b=2), warm-started across loop
meta.oracle_policy: ED used only to draw samples from a_k^2 (exact), for diagnostics E_FN/phi, and scoring
